title: PoE early league appreciating assets
text:
Investments: (Investments spike day 3, day 7 and 2-3 weeks into league on average. Items spike earlier generally)
High End Investments: Mirrors, Mirror Shards, Locks, Reflecting Mists, Awakeners orb, Veiled Exalts
Medium End Investments: Maven Chisels, Tempering/Tailoring orbs, Eldritch Currency, Orb of dominance, Divine teardrop, Fracture orbs
Low End Investments: Divine orbs primarily to protect against inflation. Alterations and regrets can be good if you buy early but are mild profit.
Item Investments: Heist bases. Sublime visions, good watchers, ice bite shako, kalandras touch, etc . GG corrupts like power charge/rmr helmets. 
Stream Sniping: Invest in what streamers are doing to resell. Stalk their characters on poe.ninja. If you invest when they make a youtube video it is too late. (Only for the true degenerates)
